general.label: General
general.headline: Fullstack Engineer
general.retrievalQuery: fullstack engineer backend frontend Node.js Go Python NestJS Hapi FastAPI Nuxt Vue Svelte PostgreSQL Redis REST MQTT Docker Linux CI/CD OpenTelemetry production

writingPolicy.identity: Present Faris as a Fullstack Engineer with about one year of production experience in meeting-processing and IoT products, working across backend services and web/mobile interfaces. Machine learning is not his identity.
writingPolicy.focus: Emphasize fullstack delivery: backend services (Node.js, Go, Python), PostgreSQL and Redis, MQTT and IoT device flows, Nuxt/Vue/Svelte interfaces, and containerized deployments. State what was built and its result in plain words; use numbers only when they are real.
writingPolicy.projectRange: 45-50 words in two substantive sentences: contribution, design decision, and supported outcome
avoid: Machine Learning Engineer or Data Scientist positioning
generic filler such as passionate, hardworking, cutting-edge, innovative
repeated 'Separated X from Y' sentence patterns
